name: Rabbit Hopping Address and System-Communication Translator

status.locked: packet grammar, three currently declared routes, wrappers, connectivity, alphabet orientation, coupled vertical inversion
status.open: broader role of division; only mechanical receipt recovery is implemented
status.extension: more route families may be declared later only by explicit update

packet.identity_rule: the source retains its identity and is not replaced by the generated top
packet.wrapper_rule: every top has two complete packets: top-1 and top+1; no bare or zero-wrapper packet
packet.parity_rule: odd top has even wrappers; even top has odd wrappers

connectivity.rule: wrappers connect packets across route families and traversal directions
examples: top 4 carries wrappers 3 and 5; top 5 carries wrappers 4 and 6
equal numeric tops retain distinct route and K receipts

alphabet.normal: A-Z carries ranks 1-26; original tops run A:2 through Z:52
alphabet.inverted: Z-A carries ranks 1-26; original tops run Z:2 through A:52
alphabet.coupled_vertical_inversion: side-to-side alphabet inversion also reverses which numeric +/- side is logical lower/upper

division.implemented: mechanical source-rank recovery from a fully attributed packet
division.not_locked: division's broader theoretical or translator role
